Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Joruun Jadecoil. Character visual motifs: stout jade-mechanical titan with hinged stone shutters and a visible counterweight core; never rolls as a ball.
TOP LEFT: Counterweight. Ability concept: damage taken fills a limited counterweight bar, up to 100, used only to strengthen hinges.
TOP RIGHT: Raise Slab. Ability concept: raises one breakable 60-GU jade slab on a ground edge for 4 s. Slab blocks movement and shots, but can be walked around. Max one slab.
BOTTOM LEFT: Hinge Swing. Ability concept: rotates the active slab 90Â° over 0.65 s, nudging units out of occupied space by at most 24 GU; without slab, Joruun gains a short self-shield but no knockup.
BOTTOM RIGHT: The Great Door. Ability concept: plants two hinged slabs 90 GU apart for 5 s, forming a **temporary gate** with an openable middle. Joruun can spend Counterweight to close it once (0.7 s telegraph); units caught in the closing zone are moved to closest free side, never trapped without exit.
